dict.string: The Hermes listens while you dictate a message to a bot or text to type on your computer.
The Hermes turns what you dictate into text. It stays on this iPhone when your language supports on-device recognition.
The Hermes asks for Face ID before it publishes or confirms a ruling that gives a bot more permissions.
The Hermes scans the pairing code your computer shows, to connect to it, and takes photos you attach to a new board item.
The Hermes connects to the Hermes service on your computer, over your own network or tailnet.
